# Confluence-jjs 5.0.194

This release focuses on stability and internal cleanup.

The Home music display and Song Popup runtime were cleaned up and simplified. Unnecessary background processing, repeated refreshes and redundant geometry updates were removed or reduced, improving stability during navigation, playback and normal library activity.

Several smaller stability fixes are included as part of this cleanup.

## Installation

Download `skin.confluence.custom-5.0.194.zip` from the release assets and install it in Kodi via **Add-ons -> Install from zip file**.

This version was device-tested before publication.
